sub: Add your material, let it be split into small topics, adjust, and create the course.

new.title: What are you studying?
new.sub: Turn your own notes, textbook chapters or handouts into a course with topics, quizzes and reviews.
new.step1: Add PDFs, Word files or pasted text.
new.step2: It's split into small topics you can learn one at a time.
new.step3: Check the topics, adjust, and start learning.
new.name: Course name
new.nameHint: For example: “Organic chemistry — unit 3”. You can change it later.

material.title: Your material
material.hint: Add one or more files, or paste text. Everything is combined in order.
material.have: {words} words in {paragraphs, plural, one {# paragraph} other {# paragraphs}}.
material.size: {paragraphs, plural, one {# paragraph} other {# paragraphs}} · {words} words
material.drop: Drop files here, or click to choose
material.types: PDF, Word (.docx) or text files, up to 20 MB each
material.added: Added {n, plural, one {# paragraph} other {# paragraphs}}
material.pastePlaceholder: Paste notes here. Blank lines separate paragraphs; # starts a heading.

split.title: Split into topics
split.hint: Each topic becomes one small thing to learn: a concept, a rule or a worked example.
split.notesPlaceholder: For example: one topic per definition; keep worked examples with their rule.
split.needKey: AI splitting needs your AI key.
split.noAi: The AI helper isn't set up — splitting by headings still works.
split.working: Reading your material… this can take up to a minute.
split.replaces: Splitting again replaces the outline below.

outline.title: Your topics
outline.summaryLine: {units, plural, one {# unit} other {# units}}, {topics, plural, one {# topic} other {# topics}}
outline.hint: Click any name to change it. Merge, split or remove topics until it feels right — changes save as you go.
outline.splitHint: Choose where the new topic starts.
outline.removed: “{title}” removed — its text won't be in the course.

create.label: Create the course
create.ready: Topics are ready to study as soon as you create them.
create.drafts: Topics arrive as drafts — publish them when students should see them.
create.go: Create {n, plural, one {# topic} other {# topics}}
create.replaceBody: Creating replaces them, including progress on them. Your material stays.

leftOut.title: Left out of the course ({n, plural, one {# paragraph} other {# paragraphs}})
leftOut.hint: These parts don't look like learning material — cover, copyright, contents, preface, index and the like — so they aren't topics. Add back anything you need.
